  "categories": [

      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Bumps the C++ language standard to C++23 in CMakeLists.txt, depends, and CI scripts, setting minimum compiler requirements to GCC 13 and Clang 19.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Raising the minimum language standard to C++23 is a strategically important compiler baseline transition across the project. As the author notes, 'the workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating' and modernizations like #34979 depend on advancing the baseline compiler support."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The release notes entry merely follows the build and codebase changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates that accompany a code change do not qualify the PR for membership in Docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/txospenderindex.cpp only for mechanical C++23 call-site refactoring.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical edits following a tree-wide modernization do not constitute an index change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches kernel files only for mechanical C++23 replacements.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates across kernel headers do not affect the kernel API, boundary, or validation architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches p2p files only for mechanical standard library call-site updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not alter P2P network behavior, protocol logic, or transport implementations."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches RPC files only to use C++23 methods and standard features.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical standard-library updates do not change RPC commands, schemas, or behaviors."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test and fuzz files to adapt to C++23 features and removes util_expected_tests.cpp following the removal of the polyfill.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deleting unit tests for a removed utility polyfill and updating call sites in tests do not change test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to tools like bitcoin-tx are incidental C++23 call-site refactors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not add features or alter tool behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes custom polyfills and compatibility wrappers including util::Expected (src/util/expected.h), src/compat/byteswap.h, and ALWAYS_FALSE in src/util/types.h in favor of std::expected and std::byteswap.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retiring internal polyfills like util::Expected in favor of standard library equivalents simplifies utility error handling across the codebase. While worthwhile maintenance that reduces internal baggage, it is deferrable internal cleanup."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches validation files only for mechanical syntax replacements.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Validation rules, consensus invariants, and chainstate handling are completely unaffected."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
